final_message:
I fixed `slugify` in `src/slugify.py`. Accented characters were being dropped instead of converted, so "Café" became `caf`. It now turns accented letters into their plain ASCII form first, so "Café Münch" gives `cafe-munch`.

The five existing tests pass. I guessed accented input was the problem from reading the code, since you didn't say which inputs fail. I didn't add a test for the accent case.

Letters with no ASCII equivalent, such as CJK characters, are still dropped. If your users hit other failing inputs, send me an example.
